text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ever since that time, surely――――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Haaai☆ I'm your roommate starting today!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "I'm Loves Only You. Nice to meet you~♡"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Loves-san... My name is Chrono Genesis."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“I may still be inexperienced, but 
please... treat me kindly.”

text_block_list.name: Loves & Chrono
text_block_list.text: "Haa... haa... haa...—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan... was truly amazing...! Her 
running was so lovely... It really got me 
fired up...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-san... your running was... 
wonderful too... I learned... a lot from 
it...――"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —I had a premonition.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I thought I would be running... in the 
same era as her. ...Yet, we Umamusume are—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even living in the same era... there are 
many times... when our paths diverge—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I have... a history that I wish to 
write... Just as Love-chan has a world she 
wishes to pursue—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
On our own paths... running memorable 
races... If we can just make our own 
history... that would be enough.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That is what I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Today... until we ran together—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Today... I was happy to run... in the 
Grand Prix... together with Love-chan. 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Would you... shake my hand?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: As rivals... who forged history together.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(――...Chrono-chan. I've actually always 
thought so too.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I was just thinking what an incredibly... 
love-driven Umamusume you are.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (—I want to be like that too.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Just like Chrono-chan... being strong 
toward my own love—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-kun. Once again, I wanted to 
say...―"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan. I wanted to ask you 
again...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: How was... my running today?
choice_data_list:
That was definitely a run that cements 
your reputation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following up the Victoria Mile with a 
result in the Takarazuka Kinen... Surely 
no one can doubt this strength now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If things keep going at this rate, it 
should lead to wonderful results the next 
time an opportunity to take on the world 
opens up...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yaay!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, aren't we in peak condition? 
If we keep this up, my channel members 
will be even happier, right!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, aren't we in peak 
condition? If we keep this up, my channel 
members will be even happier!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then let's pick our next goal 
right away! Hey, hey! Which race do you 
think we should do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At first glance, Loves Only You seems 
extremely motivated, with a bright 
expression. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but feel she was pushing 
herself, acting tough just so I wouldn't 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list:
—Next up, let's run the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list:
—Next up, let's run the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"A second Queen Elizabeth II Cup...! Yes, 
that sounds wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta show everyone that I'm not the 
same as last year♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She's only just finished the 
Takarazuka Kinen. I don't want to disturb 
her feelings by prying unnecessarily."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after sharing the next goal we had 
in mind, we headed home for the day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"—So, Loves-chan's been acting a little 
strange, and you want to consult us 
Community Members about it?"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"‘You say they're acting strange, but that 
could mean anything. What exactly is going 
on with them?’"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing herself, you say? ...Bridge-san, 
do you happen to have any idea what the 
reason might be?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—In that case, this time it's my turn to 
cheer up the comm-members!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next is my turn. If everyone is 
suffering, I want to cheer up their 
hearts, even just a little...!’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, our commu-members will be 
even happier!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, ever since the 
incident in Dubai, Loves Only You has been 
caring about the community members even 
more than before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She agonized over the community members 
suffering from the changes in society and 
life caused by the pandemic, and kept 
searching for something she could do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps those feelings towards her 
community members were forcing her to put 
on a smile—"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"‘...True, lately you could definitely 
sense everyone in the community struggling 
in real life.’"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"If worrying about that and trying to 
cheer her up is just forcing her to push 
herself too hard... Then that's something 
I really wouldn't want..."

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to worry about us like 
that! Just seeing Loves-chan work hard 
gives us plenty of encouragement!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. More than enough already... If 
anything, I wish she'd lean on us more. 
...Though, I suppose that's just not who 
she is."

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, you've already given us so 
much strength!" "Your feelings reached 
us!" "You really saved me." "We just want 
to say thank you!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Watching the members of the community 
interact makes me realize once again: 
Loves Only You and the community truly 
care for each other.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“――――Helping and supporting each other 
with love, that's what makes us who we 
are.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Her words suddenly flashed across my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That leads to an idea that might just 
resolve what currently lies between us and 
Loves Only You."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Because they care about the other 
person and worry, they bottle up the 
problem all on their own. Perhaps they're 
just like I used to be."
choice_data_list:
(In that case, what we need to do is the 
same...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...This time, it's my turn to connect 
them. Loves Only You, and the 
comm-members.
choice_data_list:
'I have something to discuss with all 
community members!'

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"What's going on?" "Leave it to me!" 
"Assemble!" "I'll do anything." "I'll 
help!" "Let me lend a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before we head to the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup—we shall create it once more. Our 
mutual love of helping and supporting one 
another...!
